# Arcade webapp fixture tree

Runtime materialization of the self-authored arcade-webapp fixture corpus
(gauntlet plan §1.3 item 6, AC-3's fixture half). **Nothing here is
committed except this README** — everything under `incoming/`, `verified/`,
and `reports/` is deterministic generated output:

- `incoming/` — dummy ROM tree, regenerated byte-identically by
  `make fixture-arcade` via `go run ./cmd/fixturegen` (SHA-256 stream keyed
  by system+filename — see `pkgs/arcade-webapp/internal/fixture`).
- `verified/` — igir's `copy test report` output (DAT-matched ROMs).
- `reports/` — igir audit CSVs.

The canonical, committed half of the corpus is the three Logiqx DATs at
`pkgs/arcade-webapp/testdata/dats/{nes,snes,gb}.dat`, whose entries embed
the hashes of the generated bytes. Both halves are ours: dummy bytes,
fake-realistic self-authored titles, zero copyrighted material.

## The gate

```sh
make fixture-arcade
```

regenerates the tree and asserts, per system: every DAT game `FOUND`, zero
`UNUSED` rows in the report (= zero unmatched input files). The offline
equivalence (generator bytes ↔ committed DAT hashes) is separately pinned by
`go test ./internal/fixture` in `pkgs/arcade-webapp`.
